newsitem.title: USA: USA Waste closes on Canadian acquisition.
newsitem.headline: USA Waste closes on Canadian acquisition.

text.p: USA Waste Services Inc said on Wednesday it had closed its previously announced US$518 million acquisition of the Canadian solid waste subsidiaries of Allied Waste Industries Inc.

USA Waste's Canadian subsidiary has signed a consent order with the Competition Tribunal in Canada to sell certain solid waste collection operations in the Sarnia, Brantford and Ottawa markets that have estimated annualized revenues of US $8 million, the company said.

In order to facilitate the divestitures in the Sarnia and Ottawa markets, the consent order requires USA Waste to provide prospective buyers with access to landfills in these markets, the company said.
